test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 17 March, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

p _ nj _ c _ r _ jlcp _ njl _ pr _ _ lc
solution:
Given sequence: p _ nj _ c _ r _ jlcp _ njl _ pr _ _ lc

1. rlpnrcnj → p **r** nj **l** c / **p** r **n** jlc / p **r** njl **c** / pr **n** **j** lc

2. rppnrcnj → p **r** nj **p** c / **p** r **n** jlc / p **r** njl **c** / pr **n** **j** lc

3. rllnrcnj → p **r** nj **l** c / **l** r **n** jlc / p **r** njl **c** / pr **n** **j** lc

4. rlprncnj → p **r** nj **l** c / **p** r **r** jlc / p **n** njl **c** / pr **n** **j** lc

 
• In option 1, 'prnjlc' is repeated.

Hence, ‘**rlpnrcnj**’ is the correct answer.
